newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Argentine economy minister cancels Brazil visit.
newsitem.headline: Argentine economy minister cancels Brazil visit.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez has canceled a trip to Brasilia for discussions on new Brazilian rules on import financing, an aide to Brazilian Finance Minister Pedro Malan said on Monday.

The aide said he did not know why the visit, scheduled for Tuesday, was canceled. He said Argentine deputy ministers of economy, foreign relations and industry and commerce would travel to the Brazilian capital instead of Fernandez.
"There will be dialogue. The Finance Ministry is certain they will be satisfied with the explanations they will be given," the aide told Reuters.
Last Tuesday, with its trade deficit already standing at more than $2.8 billion in 1997, Brazil announced new limits on import financing of less than 360 days.

The rules, which force importers with short-term financing to buy foreign currency when they pick up their goods from customs and are aimed at ending interest rate arbitrage between Brazil and abroad, have angered Brazil's Mercosur partners.
Mercosur members Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay have urged Brasilia to exempt the bloc and Chile has questioned whether it breaches a free trade deal signed between Santiago and Mercosur.
